rule: Node's createRequire(filename): resolution is relative to filename; alchemy-30: Bun 1.3.13 loses it under a CommonJS hook
reason: The alchemy migration: Neon's Nuxt build runs createRequire(import.meta.url).resolve("srvx/node") from the repository root on its pinned Bun 1.3.13, and the preload's CommonJS hook made it resolve from '' instead.
